headline: Project Manager
workPreference: Manufacturing & Production, Warehouse & Fulfillment, Skilled Trades & Industrial, Customer Service & Events
summary: Project manager with hands-on field experience and progression through multiple roles in the restoration industry. Experienced managing approximately 4-10 concurrent projects and coordinating 3-5 technicians, overseeing work from site inspection and estimating through scheduling, progress monitoring, and completion. Brings practical technical knowledge, team training, customer communication, and safety awareness to field operations and project coordination.
